Work directly in /Users/rraviku2/aarti/salus-pramana-medical and implement a deliberate end-to-end migration of ALL capabilities from archive/legacy-monorepo into the active root TanStack React/Vite/Express application. The user requires an award-quality coherent medical research workflow, not a raw copy. Preserve every current production tab, D3 chart, map, modal, dataset, and behavior.

Current state: exact production source from GitHub commit 2436937 is active at root; light medical theme; TanStack Router/Query; 9 lazy routes in src/routes; shared state in src/app; archive/legacy-monorepo contains old monorepo. Git history is stale due local Git TLS failures, so use current working files as source of truth. Do not deploy, commit, or push.

Required parity: evidence submission; editor console/publication status; Cognito-compatible auth and editor authorization; evidence/condition CRUD, search, pagination and CSV API; persistence abstraction with local fallback and DynamoDB option; immutable audit logging; PubMed, AYUSH, CTRI and ClinicalTrials.gov ingestion; runtime registry and HTTPS source allowlist validation; validation gates; drift monitoring; single-intervention trajectories; calibration reporting; relevant AWS SAM infrastructure; math/deployment/UX docs and print assets. Explicitly reconcile recency default and ODE strength/severity differences with documented decisions and tests.

Workflow: Research Home -> Discover/Search -> Compare -> Analyze interactions/trajectory/dose -> Review provenance/validation gates -> Submit evidence -> Editorial review/publish -> Calibration/governance monitoring. Place routes/navigation appropriately; use TanStack Query for server state and lazy route splitting; preserve light research theme; no placeholders/dead controls; maintain medical disclaimer/provenance/uncertainty/no-PHI policy.

Execute with TDD and phased validation. Produce migration plan and requirement traceability artifacts. Run full tests, lint, build, audit, browser route checks desktop/mobile, API smoke tests. Return concise changed-file/features/tests/prerequisites report.
